nodes.description: Biallelic SLC31A1 variants impair CTR1, the high-affinity transporter that brings copper across the plasma membrane. Mouse genetics shows CTR1 is the main route of cellular copper entry, and the index patients were described as having central nervous system copper deficiency. Whether reduced import is the primary defect for every allele is not settled: fibroblasts homozygous for p.His120Gln showed normal CTR1 protein and normal copper uptake, and the 2025 authors suggest that cytoplasmic-loop variants may instead disturb copper handoff to intracellular chaperones.
